   * into its declared space; an embedded client returns `MODEL_UNAVAILABLE`.
   * `queryAffect` (`{ valence, arousal, dominance }`: valence in -1..1,
   * arousal and dominance in 0..1) ranks by emotion congruence, embedded and
   * remote alike; out of range it returns `BAD_REQUEST`.
   * Explicit `scope.worldRef` recalls of retained foreign worlds carry
   * `item.stale`: `staleSince` and `ageSecs` (when known), `reason` and
   * `pactEpoch`. This selection grants no read authority.
   * `tokenBudget` (0: uncut) sizes the rendered `format`; omitted, the
   * window budget of `readerAgentRef`'s memory profile, else 4,000.

docs.py:
Recalls a memory pack.

        ``effort="high"`` needs a lease this package never mints: an embedded
        client raises ``LEASE_REQUIRED``; a remote one gets what the server
        serves (reranked on its ``[models]`` reranker, or unreranked and
        saying so). ``effort="call"`` is call mode for live calls:
        light effort under a hard deadline (``deadline_ms``, or the vault's
        call-mode deadline), answering with the best results ready, marked
        ``partial``. ``format`` takes the engine's exact tokens:
        ``"json"``, ``"yaml"``, ``"toon"``, ``"md"``, ``"txt"``.
        ``media`` (``{"space", "mime", "bytes_b64", "kinds"}``) is embedded
        by the server into its declared space; an embedded client raises
        ``MODEL_UNAVAILABLE``. ``query_affect`` (``{"valence", "arousal",
        "dominance"}``: valence in -1..1, arousal and dominance in 0..1)
        ranks by emotion congruence, embedded and remote alike; out of range
        it raises ``BAD_REQUEST``.
        
        Explicit ``scope.world_ref`` recalls of retained foreign worlds carry
        ``item["stale"]``: ``stale_since`` and ``age_secs`` (when known),
        ``reason`` and ``pact_epoch``. This selection grants no read authority.
        ``token_budget`` (0: uncut) sizes the rendered ``format``; omitted,
        the window budget of ``reader_agent_ref``'s memory profile, else 4,000.

verbs.name: vault.campaign.compliance.install
verbs.description: The owner installs cited compliance rows through the versioned amendment classifier; a loosening still waits for an exact-hash owner approval.

verbs.name: vault.campaign.compliance.amend
verbs.description: Proposes cited compliance rows against the active version. Tightening activates with a notice only within the caller ceiling; loosening waits for the owner stamp.

verbs.name: vault.campaign.compliance.approve
verbs.description: The owner approves the exact pending compliance proposal hash against the active version, with a durable authority receipt.

verbs.name: vault.campaign.compliance.reject
verbs.description: The owner rejects the exact pending compliance proposal hash without changing the effective rules.

verbs.name: vault.campaign.compliance.verify
verbs.description: The owner records cited verification dates for existing compliance rows, including an explicitly stale date, without changing requirements or freshness policy.

verbs.name: vault.campaign.compliance.result
verbs.description: Reads the active compliance pack, exact pending proposal, activation notices and amendment or owner-verification receipts from one snapshot.

verbs.name: vault.campaign.enroll
verbs.description: Enrolls a person in a campaign the caller owns, with evidence-backed channels and sticky senders. Writes no earned stage and sends nothing.

verbs.name: vault.campaign.stage.evidence
verbs.description: Records earned-stage evidence under an authored ladder transition, in AUTO or propose mode. Owner-attested evidence requires the request owner proof; elapsed time earns nothing.

verbs.name: vault.campaign.unsubscribe
verbs.description: Immediately honors an unsubscribe with a channel-scoped enforcement claim and every suppressed membership head in one transaction.

verbs.name: vault.campaign.program.create
verbs.description: Creates a campaign program (ordered steps and an optional saved-query audience) under a campaign the caller owns.

verbs.name: vault.campaign.program.read
verbs.description: One campaign program under a campaign the caller owns, with whether its audience gets automatic intake now.

verbs.name: vault.campaign.program.update
verbs.description: Replaces a campaign program's name, steps and audience whole under a version check; work queued at a dropped step stops.

verbs.name: vault.campaign.program.archive
verbs.description: Archives a campaign program: it stays readable, enrolls no one, and its queued enrollment work stops.

verbs.name: vault.turn_programs.arm
verbs.description: Arms a pinned callable skill entry for the caller's own future turns, in one conversation or any of its own; arming the same definition again returns the standing registration.

verbs.name: vault.turn_programs.disarm
verbs.description: Disarms one of the caller's own armed turn programs; true when it was armed.

verbs.name: self.saved_query.create
verbs.description: Creates a saved query (scope, stage-1 filter, stage-2 matcher and evaluation policy) owned by the caller.

verbs.name: self.saved_query.read
verbs.description: One saved query the caller owns; a query absent or not the caller's reads as not found.

verbs.name: self.saved_query.update
verbs.description: Replaces a saved query's scope, filter, matcher and evaluation policy whole under a definition-version check; it is how the owner accepts a pack-drift repair for a paused query, and a valid replacement resumes it.

verbs.name: self.saved_query.archive
verbs.description: Archives a saved query under a definition-version check: it stays readable and is never evaluated again.

verbs.name: self.saved_query.members
verbs.description: One cursor-bounded page of the membership this saved query derived, entered and exited causes preserved.

verbs.name: self.saved_query.evaluate
verbs.description: Evaluates a saved query the caller owns now, bounded by its per-wake caps, with one verdict and memo receipt per visited entity.

verbs.name: vault.weave.report
verbs.description: The live weave report for the bound actor, read through its own scope and the vault's weave policy for its role.

verbs.name: vault.weave.digest
verbs.description: One of the bound actor's saved weave digests, or the newest, under the current read policy. Its lens is a card; a server holds its frame for the card's events, an embedded handle holds none.

verbs.name: vault.weave.lens
verbs.description: Renders the caller's live weave report through the weave-report skill on the server's model, as a card whose wrong controls are its declared actions; the server holds its frame for the card's events.

verbs.name: vault.weave.link.wrong
verbs.description: A person labels a link in their own lens as wrong; the label teaches the loops and the link stays.

verbs.name: vault.weave.owner.link.wrong
verbs.description: The owner labels a link in the owner lens as wrong, under the owner's own credential; the label teaches the loops and the link stays.

verbs.name: vault.weave.item.wrong
verbs.description: A person labels a claim, project or budget item in their own lens as wrong; the label teaches the loops and the record stays.

verbs.name: vault.weave.owner.item.wrong
verbs.description: The owner labels a claim, project or budget item in the owner lens as wrong, under the owner's own credential; the label teaches the loops and the record stays.

verbs.name: vault.weave.enqueue
verbs.description: Admits a generated candidate weave recipe under the owner's proof and queues its pinned execution; poll vault.consolidation.status for completion.

verbs.name: vault.weave.schedules.list
verbs.description: Lists every reader's daily or weekly weave digest schedule under the owner's proof.

verbs.name: vault.weave.schedules.put
verbs.description: Sets one reader's daily or weekly digest schedule and section recipe under the owner's proof.

verbs.name: vault.weave.schedules.clear
verbs.description: Stops one reader's digest schedule under the owner's proof, keeping its saved periods.

verbs.name: vault.weave.setting_changes.list
verbs.description: Lists the Coach's proposed and applied changes to the owner's own digest rhythm and section order, newest first, under the owner's proof.

verbs.name: vault.weave.setting_changes.answer
verbs.description: Accepts, as the owner's own act, or declines one proposed change to the owner's digest settings; a stale accept applies nothing.

verbs.name: vault.weave.setting_changes.undo
verbs.description: Undoes one applied or accepted change to the owner's digest settings, restoring the rhythm and section order before it while the settings are unchanged since.

verbs.name: vault.weave.digest_feedback.put
verbs.description: Tells the Coach the owner's own digest preference: a rhythm, a section to lead with, or keep the settings as they are.

verbs.name: vault.weave.owner.digest.render
verbs.description: Publishes the owner's due digest through the live owner lens and returns the saved period and narrowing receipt, or null when nothing is due.

verbs.name: vault.inbox.concerns.review
verbs.description: Queues the Coach's real health review under the owner's proof; findings and recipients come from engine evidence, never supplied concern rows.

verbs.name: vault.inbox.lens
verbs.description: Reads the owner's cross-identity inbox lens in impact order, optionally filtered by identity or agent, with concern groups per agent.

verbs.name: vault.inbox.groups
verbs.description: Reads membership of real gate-held Dreamer consent proposals grouped by run, under the owner's proof.

verbs.name: vault.weave.digest.render
verbs.description: Publishes the bound reader's due digest through the same live scoped lens and returns its saved period and narrowing receipt, or null when nothing is due.

verbs.name: vault.weave.link.corrections
verbs.description: Reads persisted wrong-link labels for a link still admitted by the caller's live weave lens, without changing the link.

verbs.name: self.inbox.lens
verbs.description: Reads the bound actor's own identity inbox slice in impact order, with optional identity filtering and concern groups; not a delivered-notification page.

verbs.name: vault.skills.bootstrap
verbs.description: Reads the bootstrap four and their actual resident source, lifecycle and receipts without seeding or restoring missing skills.

verbs.name: vault.skill_hubs.default.get
verbs.description: Reads the first hub identity, configured mirror endpoint and pinned skill-root ref; owner hub and ref setters configure that source.

verbs.name: vault.skills.restoreDefaults
verbs.description: The owner explicitly re-imports missing or retired bootstrap and pinned first-hub defaults as fresh candidates, leaving unchanged defaults and local forks alone.

verbs.name: vault.skill_hubs.put
verbs.description: The owner registers or revises a hub source; hub trust never grants activation authority.

verbs.name: vault.skill_hubs.get
verbs.description: Reads one configured hub as the owner.

verbs.name: vault.skill_hubs.publishers.admit
verbs.description: The owner admits a foreign publisher to offer candidates from one configured hub, and nothing else.

verbs.name: vault.skill_hubs.publishers.revoke
verbs.description: The owner revokes the exact offer-only publisher grant; foreign hooks recheck it before running.

verbs.name: vault.skill_hubs.refs.get
verbs.description: Reads one hub ref policy, pin and separate seen and trusted revisions as the owner.

verbs.name: vault.skill_hubs.refs.set
verbs.description: The owner changes one hub ref policy and pin without fetching or trusting new bytes.

verbs.name: vault.packs.install
verbs.description: The owner fetches a pinned hub pack as its foreign publisher; code stays Candidate and hooks wait for consent.

verbs.name: vault.packs.sync
verbs.description: The owner syncs a hub pack at its stored ref policy; wider hooks keep their old bindings until re-consent.

verbs.name: vault.packs.get
verbs.description: Reads an installed pack and its exact source, pin, publisher and requested powers as the owner.

verbs.name: vault.skills.import
verbs.description: The owner imports a pinned hub skill through scanning and publisher admission, pending its permission ask.

verbs.name: vault.skills.sync
verbs.description: The owner syncs a hub skill under its ref policy; widening proposes without changing trusted capabilities.

verbs.name: vault.skills.receipts
verbs.description: Reads every hub source and import receipt of a skill, and its held-out admission ruling, as the owner.

verbs.name: vault.skills.convert
verbs.description: Converts selected messages through the configured refiner; user initiation approves conversion, never admission.

verbs.name: vault.skills.get
verbs.description: Reads skill lifecycle, exact source, provenance, source availability, scan and admission receipts, and retained fork ancestry.

verbs.name: vault.skills.list
verbs.description: Lists a page of the owner skill library, including inactive skills and their retained evidence.

verbs.name: vault.skills.archive
verbs.description: The owner soft-retires an active skill without deleting its body, source or receipts; running callable invocations are cancelled.

verbs.name: vault.skills.restore
verbs.description: The owner restores an archived skill through the same admission gates; a hub restore prepares exact consent and reruns held-out scoring.

verbs.name: vault.skills.fork
verbs.description: The owner, or a person or agent on its own slip within its write Grant, forks a stored skill it can read under a new identity through the existing fork law; retained parent/version and hub ancestry remain inspectable.

verbs.name: vault.skills.rules.set
verbs.description: The owner sets or clears a known-bad canonical skill hash rule, independently of advisory scanner prose.

verbs.name: vault.skills.code_auto_install.set
verbs.description: The owner sets the code auto-install switch through its existing consent gate; the switch grants no sandbox qualification.

verbs.name: vault.skills.permissions.approve
verbs.description: The owner answers one imported skill permission ask at its exact hub source.

verbs.name: vault.skills.optimize.start
verbs.description: The owner starts one skill_optimize attempt on the Dreamer queue; a named identity or alignment skill is excluded and never enqueued.

verbs.name: vault.skills.optimize.result
verbs.description: Reads a started skill_optimize job, its drafted proposal, the incumbent, its governance and every held-out verdict on the proposal.

verbs.name: vault.projects.goal.intake.complete
verbs.description: Completes the witnessed human goal-intake interview with the full confirmed record; no agent proposal can write the effective goal.

verbs.name: vault.projects.goal.get
verbs.description: Reads the full effective goal record and its claim together; interview drafts and loop proposals never replace it.

verbs.name: vault.skills.optimize.propose
verbs.description: Submits one explicit optimizer candidate against a fixed baseline version and a real drafting attempt; ordinary held-out admission still rules.

verbs.name: vault.skills.optimize.measure
verbs.description: Judges held-out floors before any online slice, then measures the proposal on the effective goal with the registered judge and bounded live arms.

verbs.name: vault.skills.optimize.score
verbs.description: Rules on the submitted proposal through the existing held-out vector gate, floors and tradeoff ladder, without activating it.

verbs.name: vault.skills.optimize.admit
verbs.description: Admits only a standing gate acceptance and supersedes its incumbent atomically, with current body, evidence, tier, goal and owner checks.

verbs.name: vault.skills.optimize.goal.get
verbs.description: Reads the optimizer goal identity, effective axes, revision and joined project goal claim.

verbs.name: vault.skills.optimize.goal.bind
verbs.description: Joins a skill goal to the human project goal record, or unbinds with null; every join changes its admission revision.

verbs.name: vault.skills.optimize.preferences.get
verbs.description: Reads authored and learned goal tradeoff rules and the typed judgment band, without changing authority.

verbs.name: vault.skills.optimize.preferences.set
verbs.description: The responsible owner sets authored tradeoff rules and the typed judgment band, retaining learned picks and every admission clamp.

verbs.name: vault.skills.optimize.tradeoff_asks
verbs.description: Lists the exact pending optimizer tradeoffs that have reached a role the caller holds, including bound typed judgment evidence.

verbs.name: vault.skills.optimize.tradeoff_asks.pick
verbs.description: Approves or rejects the exact shown tradeoff; the attributed pick becomes a preference and a proposed project revision, never a Grant.

verbs.name: vault.skills.governance.get
verbs.description: Reads one skill governance tier as the owner, resolved fail-closed, and whether the automated edit loop may consider it.

verbs.name: vault.skills.governance.set
verbs.description: The owner marks or clears one skill governance tier; the mark changes no instruction content or version.

verbs.name: vault.packs.hooks.bind
verbs.description: The owner consents to the installed pack hook capabilities, including a widening update; publisher identity stays foreign.

verbs.name: vault.packs.hooks.list
verbs.description: Reads live pack hook bindings and their effective read grants as the owner, excluding revoked foreign publisher grants.

verbs.name: vault.packs.hooks.grant.set
verbs.description: The owner sets or changes a live hook binding's read grant; outcomes still run as the hook's author. Returns the assigned grant.

verbs.name: vault.packs.hooks.grant.get
verbs.description: Reads a live hook binding's effective read grant as the owner: its manual assignment, or the author's ceiling when none was set.

verbs.name: vault.packs.hooks.qualify
verbs.description: The owner qualifies a Candidate hub hook pack by real sandbox replay; qualification does not consent to wider hooks.

verbs.name: vault.packs.put
verbs.description: The owner installs a pack folder, or replaces the pack installed under its name, each file sent as text or as content_base64 bytes; the put is the consent for its hooks.

verbs.name: vault.packs.preview
verbs.description: The owner previews a pack folder before vault.packs.put: the world its travelling agent would land in, with a please double-check notice when that world's current setting does not cover this machine; nothing is staged or written.

verbs.name: vault.packs.connector.prepare
verbs.description: Prepares an immutable connector pack admission, comparing the resolved declaration with the installed transport and drafting an ungranted slate.

verbs.name: vault.packs.connector.get
verbs.description: Reads a connector pack source, resolved manifest, advisory evidence, qualification and owner-stampable capability rows.

verbs.name: vault.packs.connector.qualify
verbs.description: Runs the real connector probes bound to the exact pack source and protocol; qualification grants nothing without the owner slate and actor grant.

verbs.name: vault.packs.connector.accept
verbs.description: Stamps the exact connector pack manifest and grant rows once, or revokes a row; qualification stays independent.

verbs.name: vault.packs.connector.update
verbs.description: Holds a connector pack at its new immutable source and protocol, carrying narrow rows and re-asking only for expanded capabilities.

verbs.name: vault.packs.connector.grants.get
verbs.description: Reads current per-capability authority for one actor on the reviewed connector pack source.

verbs.name: vault.packs.connector.grants.put
verbs.description: Grants declared connector pack rows to one actor through the existing owner consent gate and installed endpoint.

verbs.name: vault.packs.remove
verbs.description: The owner removes an installed pack: it leaves the Active catalog and its hook bindings stop; a built-in goes back to its Candidate.

verbs.name: vault.packs.sections.propose
verbs.description: The caller offers one typed plugin section manifest. A code-free section requesting no permission the caller lacks installs at once (vault.packs.sections.revoke undoes it); anything else waits for the owner as a proposed install claim.

verbs.name: vault.packs.sections.list
verbs.description: Plugin sections as they stand: one page of install offers awaiting the owner with their total and a cursor to the rest, admitted sections with their granted manifests, and the sections installed packs project.

verbs.name: vault.packs.sections.grant
verbs.description: The owner grants exactly the reviewed plugin section install: the claim settles through its review handle and the section is admitted under that same consent.

verbs.name: vault.packs.sections.revoke
verbs.description: The owner revokes a plugin section grant by retracting its install claim; the section and its advertised verbs leave the next board rebuild.

verbs.name: vault.packs.sections.suggest
verbs.description: Runs one workflow-pattern suggestion pass over a pinned hub on the caller's credential: a repeating pattern nominates at most one pack as an attributed proposal.

verbs.name: vault.packs.sections.suggestions.get
verbs.description: The owner's plugin suggestion knob: whether workflow-pattern suggestion passes may run at all.

verbs.name: vault.packs.sections.suggestions.set
verbs.description: The owner turns plugin suggestions on or off; off silences every later pass before any catalog is consulted.

verbs.name: ai.chat.completions
verbs.description: Recalls scoped memory, injects it as data, forwards a buffered OpenAI chat call and proposes the exchange under the paired connector's own ceiling.

verbs.name: vault.connectors.proxy.admit
verbs.description: The owner admits the OpenAI memory proxy for one paired actor, stamping its read and remember slate and activating its connector key.

verbs.name: vault.connectors.proxy.revoke_write
verbs.description: The owner withdraws only the proxy remember grant at the reviewed key and slate revision; read access, stored memories and the connector remain intact.

verbs.name: vault.connectors.slates.redraft
verbs.description: The owner asks the configured drafter to re-draft one connector grant slate: it proposes changed rows with rationale at the reviewed revision and stamps or grants nothing; with no drafter it answers unavailable.

verbs.name: vault.connectors.slates.narrow
verbs.description: The holder of a connector key tightens rows or facets of what its own key's calls meet, with no stamp; it never widens or changes a shared catalog slate, and the owner's ruling on a row reverses it.

verbs.name: vault.connectors.slates.scope_outcome
verbs.description: The owner rules on a held connector call's typed scope exceed, linked to the ask he ruled on: it folds once into that row's consent ramp and, once earned, drafts a proposed delta slate; nothing is stamped or granted.

verbs.name: vault.connectors.slates.revision_offers
verbs.description: Lists the proposed connector slate revisions waiting on the owner: earned scope-exceed offers still standing and not held back, and issuer changes not yet accepted; listing activates nothing.

verbs.name: vault.connectors.slates.defer_revision
verbs.description: The owner holds a scope-exceed revision offer back (not now, or pinned manual) or unpins it, through the consent ramp's own answers; it never accepts the offer or mints a grant.

verbs.name: vault.connectors.slates.accept_revision
verbs.description: The owner stamps one proposed connector slate revision at the revision he reviewed, rechecked: a scope revision mints its widened grant; an issuer revision accepts the new issuer so the rows it held run again.

verbs.name: vault.connectors.slates.reask_issuer
verbs.description: The owner records the issuer a catalog connector's credential slot answers for: the first is the baseline; another issuer holds only the keys and rows that depend on that slot and drafts their re-ask.

verbs.name: vault.connectors.subscriptions.put
verbs.description: The owner subscribes an agent to the messages a built-in channel (slack or line) routes to it, so each one wakes the agent to answer.

verbs.name: vault.connectors.subscriptions.list
verbs.description: An agent's connector event subscriptions, standing and revoked, for the owner.

verbs.name: vault.connectors.subscriptions.revoke
verbs.description: The owner stops one connector event subscription; the agent's key for the channel stays.

verbs.name: vault.packs.setup.prepare
verbs.description: The owner opens, or resumes, a pack's guided setup; opening grants nothing.

verbs.name: vault.packs.setup.get
verbs.description: A pack's guided setup as it stands, for the owner.

verbs.name: vault.packs.setup.answer
verbs.description: The owner's one typed answer or card action in a pack's guided setup; a credential value never passes here.

verbs.name: vault.packs.setup.verify
verbs.description: Checks one pack connection with the engine's fixed read-only provider call for its declared check.

verbs.name: vault.authority.audit
verbs.description: One page of the dated authority log audit, for the owner: grants, revokes and confirms. On a vault that adopted a checkpoint image a page can also carry cold, checkpoint-attested rows it does not store, with no clock or kind.

verbs.name: vault.authority.history.export
verbs.description: Exports the full original signed authority history, including quarantined forks, as base64 envelopes for the owner. No signing secret leaves.

verbs.name: vault.authority.history.import
verbs.description: Imports original base64 signed authority envelopes atomically for the owner, preserving bytes and refolding locally. Invalid signatures, foreign genesis and missing parents write nothing.

verbs.name: vault.authority.clock.repair
verbs.description: Repairs a damaged authority clock floor for the owner from this vault's own observations, judged against the owner's proof in the repair's own writer. A whole floor, or one nothing here proves, is left as it is and the answer says so.

verbs.name: vault.wire_health.thresholds.get
verbs.description: The owner reads the serving host's per-verb and per-actor wire detection thresholds and their window; crossings ask a health question, never refuse for rate.

verbs.name: vault.wire_health.thresholds.set
verbs.description: The owner replaces the serving host's positive wire detection thresholds and window, receiving the previous and installed policy without adding a rate refusal.

verbs.name: vault.slim.policy
verbs.description: Reads the serving host idle policy: the long outbound wait, no exit on idle and lazy heap rebuild.

verbs.name: vault.slim.state
verbs.description: Observes FULL or SLIM atomically with this process id and the retained journaled resume pointer, without waking the vault.

verbs.name: vault.slim.resume_step
verbs.description: Reads a saved model checkpoint or outbound intent by its retained identity, including after FULL or restart, without reissuing it.

verbs.name: vault.slim.drop_heavy
verbs.description: Drops rebuildable heap in process and returns the completed engine transition, drop counts or typed refusal; one journaled outbound step is required.

verbs.name: vault.slim.resume
verbs.description: Resumes logical FULL in the same process and returns its completion receipt; indexes rebuild lazily and no saved outbound step is reissued.

verbs.name: vault.mesh.path_receipts
verbs.description: The newest path receipts this machine's paired-machine mesh left, newest first and bounded: direct or relayed, admitted, refused or failed, for the owner.

verbs.name: vault.mesh.identity
verbs.description: This install's public mesh keys and both binding proofs, for the owner; no private key or grant is returned.

verbs.name: vault.mesh.bind_machine
verbs.description: Bind a paired MACHINE's address and transport key using both possession proofs; the binding starts with no ALPN grants.

verbs.name: vault.mesh.set_alpn_grant
verbs.description: Allow or revoke one exact ALPN for a paired MACHINE and endpoint key, under the caller's own owner proof.

verbs.name: vault.mesh.revoke_machine
verbs.description: Permanently revoke a MACHINE's mesh admission and all its ALPN grants; a new enrollment needs a new MACHINE and pairing.

verbs.name: vault.mesh.dial
verbs.description: Dial an explicit mesh address with this install's real key, including before pairing; report admission and close without an application stream.

verbs.name: vault.inspection.resolve
verbs.description: Resolves an inspection handle for the caller; unreadable, missing and wrong-kind targets all answer with no item.

verbs.name: vault.shared.propose_delete
verbs.description: Starts a shared vault's delete_vault act, returned as a typed pending act.

verbs.name: vault.shared.propose_transfer
verbs.description: Starts a shared vault's transfer_ownership act: a live Owner hands the vault to another person.

verbs.name: vault.shared.propose_remove_owner
verbs.description: Starts a shared vault's remove_owner act, with its export-first answer.

verbs.name: vault.shared.execute
verbs.description: A live Owner runs a matured shared-vault act and gets its receipt.

verbs.name: vault.shared.receipt
verbs.description: One shared-act or membership receipt its reader was told about, by id.

verbs.name: vault.shared.outcomes
verbs.description: The reader's own outcome notices for a shared vault.

verbs.name: vault.shared.deletion
verbs.description: The executed delete-the-vault act, if any.

verbs.name: vault.org_admin.configure
verbs.description: The owner fixes an organization's Admin identities and closed named-power set once; no root or private-vault power can be configured.

verbs.name: vault.org_admin.powers
verbs.description: The caller reads only the organization's fixed named Admin powers that their own credential carries.

verbs.name: vault.members.reset_project_access
verbs.description: An Admin resets only a non-root shared project's signed access roster through the existing project-proof gate; it never changes a personal root or grants an unsigned override.

verbs.name: vault.members.delegate
verbs.description: A live parent Admin or Owner mints one explicit scope narrowing for a holder, bounded by policy and a server-clock expiry of at most 90 days; the Delegate cannot delegate onward.

verbs.name: vault.members.projection
verbs.description: Read a member's visible role grants, scopes, expiry and person/relationship through the caller's own scoped read; relationship labels confer no additional authority.

verbs.name: vault.members.add
verbs.description: An Admin invites a live person into a shared vault at a non-root role; they join when they accept. Given the invitee's own device key, the host also mints the invitee a slip good only for this invitation while it is pending.

verbs.name: vault.members.invitation_slip
verbs.description: An Admin mints a pending invitation's slip for the public key the invitee generated on their own device: a founding invitation's, or one whose slip was lost.

verbs.name: vault.members.change
verbs.description: An Admin assigns another non-root role to a member who is not an Owner.

verbs.name: vault.members.remove
verbs.description: An Admin removes one member from a shared vault.

verbs.name: vault.members.leave
verbs.description: A member leaves a shared vault under their own proof; an Owner leaves through remove_owner instead.

verbs.name: vault.members.invitations
verbs.description: The caller's own pending invitations into a shared vault.

verbs.name: vault.members.accept
verbs.description: The invitee accepts their own invitation and joins the shared vault at its role.

verbs.name: vault.members.decline
verbs.description: The invitee declines their own invitation; nothing is granted.

verbs.name: vault.members.withdraw_invitation
verbs.description: An Admin with the add_member power takes back a pending invitation.

verbs.name: vault.shared.object
verbs.description: A holder of a pending shared act's objector role objects inside its veto window.

verbs.name: vault.shared.withdraw_objection
verbs.description: The holder withdraws their objection; past the deadline the last withdrawal releases the act.

verbs.name: vault.shared.started
verbs.description: The caller's own notices of shared acts started in the vault.

verbs.name: vault.shared.matured
verbs.description: The caller's own notices of shared acts whose veto window has passed.

verbs.name: vault.shared.erase_ask
verbs.description: A Member requests, or an Admin proposes, that the Owners erase a record; it erases nothing.

verbs.name: vault.shared.erase_asks
verbs.description: The erase asks the caller may see: every ask for an Owner, their own for anyone else.

verbs.name: vault.shared.close_erase_ask
verbs.description: An Owner closes an open erase ask, as erased (naming its erase act) or declined.

verbs.name: vault.shared.policy.get
verbs.description: A live Owner reads every shared-act policy row of a shared vault: the rows its kind ships, the vault's own rows, the row each act resolves to, and the policy_hash a change binds.

verbs.name: vault.shared.policy.propose
verbs.description: A live policy editor proposes one shared-act policy row change against the policy_hash they read; it applies only when every live editor approves it, and one no vetoes it.

verbs.name: vault.shared.policy.answer
verbs.description: A live policy editor approves or vetoes a pending shared-act policy change under their own credential; the last approval of the live editor set writes the row.

verbs.name: vault.shared.policy.change
verbs.description: A live Owner reads one shared-act policy change: its row, approvals, veto, state and the live editors it still waits on.

verbs.name: vault.federation.coreference.link
verbs.description: The owner atomically links two people with proposed or confirmed identity status, without pooling their claims or granting reads.

verbs.name: vault.federation.coreference.confirm
verbs.description: The owner atomically confirms cross-vault identity without changing either person or their claims.

verbs.name: vault.federation.coreference.share_consent
verbs.description: The owner consents to exporting an existing identity link into exactly one named federation pact.

verbs.name: vault.federation.coreference.unlink
verbs.description: The owner atomically removes both identity-link orientations and retracts link metadata while retaining the original claims.

verbs.name: vault.federation.burst.baseline
verbs.description: The owner reads one peer's named or observed baseline, relative rate and streak, and current vault-size context.

verbs.name: vault.federation.burst.policy
verbs.description: The owner reads one grant-bound peer's relative-burst outcome policy.

verbs.name: vault.federation.burst.policy.set
verbs.description: The owner sets a named baseline and allow, isolate-and-propose or defer routing for one peer without changing its grant.

verbs.name: vault.federation.burst.ingress
verbs.description: The owner admits a peer host signed Connect delivery through current federation admission and receives its discriminated burst receipt.

verbs.name: vault.federation.burst.disposition
verbs.description: The owner reads an authenticated batch original disposition, named baseline context and current durable replay state.

verbs.name: vault.federation.burst.review
verbs.description: The owner reads retained peer review bundles, coalesced once per peer and kept after replay or rejection.

verbs.name: vault.federation.burst.review.release
verbs.description: The owner releases a bundle's burst hold for current-grant replay without importing evidence or widening authority.

verbs.name: vault.federation.burst.review.reject
verbs.description: The owner rejects a bundle's pending batches while retaining its review evidence and terminal dispositions.

verbs.name: vault.federation.burst.replay
verbs.description: The owner retries one retained authenticated batch through its current grant and federation admission without another burst debit.

verbs.name: vault.federation.connect.identity
verbs.description: The owner reads this vault identity and the host key used for reciprocal Connect consent.

verbs.name: vault.federation.connect.grants.mint
verbs.description: The owner mints an inert Connect guest grant inside the named local-world ceiling.

verbs.name: vault.federation.connect.offer
verbs.description: The owner asks the host to sign one disclosed Connect half without activating it.

verbs.name: vault.federation.connect.accept
verbs.description: The owner accepts the peer host signed Connect half and receives the matching host counter-half.

verbs.name: vault.federation.connect.narrow
verbs.description: The owner narrows the current outbound scope without breaking the reciprocal relationship.

verbs.name: vault.federation.connect.rescope.offer
verbs.description: The owner discloses both directions at a new epoch and asks the host to sign a reciprocal re-scope proposal.

verbs.name: vault.federation.connect.rescope.accept
verbs.description: The owner accepts the peer host signed re-scope and receives the matching signed counter-half.

verbs.name: vault.federation.connect.disconnect
verbs.description: The owner unilaterally ends both directions of a pact without claiming to erase the peer retained copy.

verbs.name: vault.federation.connect.export
verbs.description: The owner exports one grant-filtered named-world update signed by the host for its live pact and epoch.

verbs.name: vault.federation.connect.rejoin
verbs.description: The owner admits a peer host signed update through guest admission into the retained foreign-world vault.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.name
verbs.description: A live person names another live person of the vault as their trusted contact, reached on one outbound channel verb, with an ask-first dial; naming again replaces it and needs the contact's consent again.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.list
verbs.description: A live person lists every trusted-contact relation they are a side of: those they named and those naming them, under their own credential.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.consent
verbs.description: The named contact, a live person under their own credential, accepts the naming version they were shown and attests they are an adult; the relation is live only after this.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.revoke
verbs.description: Either side of a trusted-contact relation ends it under their own credential; no notice staged from it is sent after this returns, and its open asks close.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.dial.set
verbs.description: A person changes whether they are asked before their trusted contact is reached (ask_first or just_call); the contact's consent stands.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.tier.set
verbs.description: The vault owner names the trusted-contact tier (concern or imminent) of one RouteToHelp policy row; a row never named is a concern.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.concern.asks
verbs.description: A person reads their own open asks to reach a trusted contact, each raised by a RouteToHelp the policy gate settled.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.concern.authorize
verbs.description: A person answers one of their own open asks, once: a yes stages the fact-of-concern notice (staged, not delivered) and returns the notices that tell the person and the model; a no or a superseded ask stages nothing.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.concern.propose
verbs.description: The owner's policy gate reads one message the caller reads, fresh; a RouteToHelp asks the owner or stages a just-call notice, and the answer carries only the fact of concern, the gate receipt, open asks and notices.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.concern.deliver
verbs.description: The caller sends the next staged fact-of-concern notice it is the stored sender of, as itself, through the consent-checked outbound dispatch; null when none is eligible, never another sender's notice.

verbs.name: vault.guests.share
verbs.description: The owner shares a locally authored named-world document through its live guest grant as a filtered signed envelope bound to the pact epoch.

verbs.name: vault.guests.export_envelope
verbs.description: The guest fetches its actual filtered signed document envelope under its own live grant-bound credential over HTTP or the held socket.

verbs.name: vault.guests.reshare
verbs.description: The owner attempts a document re-share through the same local-world-only guest door; received foreign worlds and base are refused.

verbs.name: vault.guests.mint_slip
verbs.description: The owner mints an Ask or active Connect guest capability slip bound to its live grant and the public key generated by the guest on their own device, with an optional signed comm cap (below vault, owners only).

verbs.name: vault.support_grants.mint
verbs.description: The owner mints our support person or agent a time-limited, revocable grant, bound to that party's own key, inside explicit bounds.

verbs.name: vault.support_grants.list
verbs.description: The owner lists the vault's support grants, newest first, with each one's bounds, deadline, status and revoke command.

verbs.name: vault.support_grants.revoke
verbs.description: The owner revokes one support grant; what support already read is not recalled.

verbs.name: vault.files.sources.attach
verbs.description: The owner attaches a folder of this host to its Files world, opting in on the first one: a world read on this install only, with no sealed copy. Its files land and its first rescan runs; the host's rescans keep it current.

verbs.name: vault.files.sources.rescan
verbs.description: The owner rescans one Files source now, or every one: new files land, changed files supersede, files with no text are held by name, missing files retract.

verbs.name: vault.files.sources.detach
verbs.description: The owner detaches a Files source: no rescan reads its folder again and its ledger goes; the notes it landed stay.

verbs.name: vault.files.sources.list
verbs.description: The owner lists this install's Files world and every Files source, with each one's exclusions and ledger counts.

verbs.name: vault.files.sources.files
verbs.description: The owner reads one Files source's ledger: each file's path, readiness (text or name only, and why), revision and dates.

verbs.name: vault.residence.mode
verbs.description: Switches one of the owner's machines between opened and all residence; that machine's own sync connection applies it. A machine this host does not reach answers state queued, naming the directive.

verbs.name: vault.residence.open
verbs.description: Opens one item on the named machine and reports local or home residence; a NOTE includes typed text, its version and requested stable anchors. A machine this host does not reach answers state queued, naming the directive.

verbs.name: vault.residence.index
verbs.description: The thin index one of the owner's machines holds, window by window: what exists, never a body. A machine this host does not reach answers state queued, naming the directive.

verbs.name: vault.residence.prune
verbs.description: Drops the opened-item caches one of the owner's machines last touched before a time. A machine this host does not reach answers state queued, naming the directive.

verbs.name: vault.residence.directives
verbs.description: The owner reads the residence directives this replica holds and each machine's result as received here; a null result means not received here, not that the machine is idle.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.start
verbs.description: The vault's owner, or a person or agent who then manages it with the owner, enters an off-record session alone, off record or anonymous, under their own name for it, and answers the handle later calls name it by.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.status
verbs.description: The session's creator or the vault's owner reads one live off-record session: its mode, backend, entry time, promoted turns and whether it is closing; a room's member reads what their membership shows.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.witness
verbs.description: The session's creator or the vault's owner witnesses one turn into an off-record session, or a member into a room's; it stays in the room until promoted or dropped at close.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.discard
verbs.description: The session's creator or the vault's owner closes an off-record session without saving it: its turns, writes, receipts and spilled outputs are dropped, and promoted turns stay.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.recall
verbs.description: The session's creator or the vault's owner recalls over an off-record session and the vault together, on their own credential: rows the room holds and vault rows alike.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.notes.create
verbs.description: The session's creator or the vault's owner writes one NOTE into an off-record session through its handle; it lands in the room, never in the vault, and close drops it.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.claims.upsert
verbs.description: The session's creator or the vault's owner admits one claim into an off-record session through its handle and the gate; it lands in the room beside the vault heads, and close drops it.

verbs.name: self.off_record.execute
verbs.description: The session's creator or the vault's owner runs one entry of a durable code-mode run bound to an off-record session; its rows, spilled outputs and type feedback stay in the room until close, its feedback beside the answer.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.rooms.status
verbs.description: Reads a room's off-record notices and waiting save suggestions as the caller's membership shows them, without the talk.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.rooms.start
verbs.description: A person, or an agent within its Write Grant, starts an off-record stretch in a room they belong to, on their own credential.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.rooms.witness
verbs.description: Witnesses a turn into a room's off-record stretch as the caller, under their live membership and the current saving grant.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.rooms.save
verbs.description: A holder of this vault's write grant saves the visible whole talk so far into this vault, on their own credential.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.rooms.save_from_here
verbs.description: A holder puts a room's stretch on record for later turns while their vault write grant and room membership stay live.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.rooms.export
verbs.description: A person or an agent on its own slip exports only its visible room talk as a JSON attachment with a content-free notice; an Owner's export also writes an audit row and tells members of each private thread it holds that the Owner is not in.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.rooms.suggest_save
verbs.description: An agent suggests saving a room's off-record talk on a write or propose credential; nothing is saved until a holder confirms.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.rooms.confirm_save
verbs.description: A holder confirms the room's waiting save suggestions with their own save of the visible whole talk; refuses when none waits.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.rooms.decline_save
verbs.description: A holder declines the room's waiting save suggestions, posts a content-free notice and saves nothing; refuses when none waits.

verbs.name: vault.records.erase_preview
verbs.description: What erasing one record would take: the brief grants it revokes, the records holding the same bytes and the LFS chunks it shares, with the digest erase_confirm takes back.

verbs.name: vault.records.erase_confirm
verbs.description: Erase the record the caller previewed, once its preview still has the digest they confirmed; in a shared vault a held record starts its own erase act instead.

verbs.name: vault.records.erase_sweep
verbs.description: Read a redaction receipt's recorded historical-sweep deadline and linked completion as the owner; never starts a sweep.

verbs.name: vault.research.create_child
verbs.description: The owner enqueues an experiment child through ordinary agent dispatch under an unpruned campaign parent; record its actual candidate afterward with research.fork or research.weave.

verbs.name: vault.research.archive
verbs.description: Reads the complete retained campaign record, including every pruned, buggy and woven candidate, original search and held-out evidence, selection rounds and promotion receipts, under the controller gate.

verbs.name: vault.research.archive.install
verbs.description: Installs one immutable campaign output descriptor from a receipted Coach proposal under the current human goal; categorical axes and embedding clusters share the engine validator.

verbs.name: vault.research.archive.record
verbs.description: Records original placement and quality receipts for one output revision; categorical judgment or pinned embedding placement competes only within its own cell.

verbs.name: vault.research.archive.get
verbs.description: Reads the installed campaign output descriptor and every original placement and scoring receipt, including losing outputs, under the research controller gate.

verbs.name: vault.research.archive.best
verbs.description: Rebuilds one best output per cell under the immutable descriptor revision and reports whether bunching warrants a new campaign proposal.

verbs.name: vault.research.archive.repropose
verbs.description: Installs a receipted descriptor proposal in a new bound campaign when the old archive is bunched; the old descriptor, goal and cell winners remain unchanged.

verbs.name: vault.research.archive.coverage
verbs.description: Pins the incumbent and candidate replay output refs and projects the human goal coverage floor; promotion rechecks these receipts and rejects any lost incumbent cell.

verbs.name: vault.evals.inventory
verbs.description: The owner reads the metadata-only eval-authoring inventory: real receipt families, grounded case candidates, date-cut cohorts and exposure counts. Pin its built_at and digest for cohort setup.

verbs.name: vault.evals.cohorts.setup
verbs.description: The owner sets up sealed cohorts from a pinned real inventory through the existing family, case and audited cut doors. Reports refused decisions; never serves sealed content or fabricates labels or skill provenance.

verbs.name: vault.evals.author_now
verbs.description: Queue the production Coach eval-authoring pass, coalescing with nightly work; the caller supplies no plan, skill provenance or lease.

verbs.name: vault.evals.authoring.result
verbs.description: Read the eval-authoring host attempt's actual state and terminal error; a completed pass may author nothing.

verbs.name: vault.evals.families
verbs.description: Read a seat's family purposes, source roots, derivative lineage and dates, including retirement and training eligibility, without sealed labels.

verbs.name: vault.evals.families.assign
verbs.description: Assign source roots their fixed eval family and purpose before deriving cases; conflicting families, purposes or seats refuse.

verbs.name: vault.evals.cases
verbs.description: Read development or judge-audit eval cases; sealed confirmation refuses and retired cohorts read as development, never training.

verbs.name: vault.evals.cases.record
verbs.description: Record a receipt, repair, paraphrase, summary, translation, synthetic or rubric case through the shared family-inheritance guard; no labels are invented.

verbs.name: vault.evals.cohorts
verbs.description: Read date-cut cohorts, the fixed reference, retirement decisions, exposure counts and near-copy audits; similarity flags review only.

verbs.name: vault.evals.cohorts.open
verbs.description: Count a candidate, query or promotion serving before releasing its sealed cohort in the same owner-validated transaction; retired cohorts refuse.

verbs.name: vault.evals.exposure
verbs.description: Read a cohort's individual exposure ledger and independent candidate, query and promotion counts; unknown cohorts refuse.

verbs.name: vault.evals.sufficiency
verbs.description: Compute the existing sufficiency card from explicit family-grouped measurements; unknown never approves, creates a label ask or deploys.

verbs.name: vault.evals.labels.blocked
verbs.description: Read only unanswered eval-label asks for this owner, optionally by seat or blocked decision, with scoped cases and quoted human minutes; create no standing label session.

verbs.name: vault.evals.labels.pick
verbs.description: Record either option of the responsible owner's existing eval-label ask once; the same pick repeats safely and a conflicting second pick refuses.

verbs.name: vault.coach.training_offers
verbs.description: Read Coach offer snapshots, their exact owner answers and later promise checks; optionally select a seat or only pending offers.

verbs.name: vault.coach.training_offers.get
verbs.description: Read one Coach offer snapshot with its owner answer and receipt-backed promise checks.

verbs.name: vault.coach.training_offers.trigger
verbs.description: Queue one production Coach training-offer pass under the owner proof; the offer skill decides what to raise and no caller supplies an offer body.

verbs.name: vault.coach.training_offers.result
verbs.description: Read the production Coach offer attempt state and the exact snapshots it raised; a completed pass may raise no offer.

verbs.name: vault.coach.training_offers.answer
verbs.description: Answer the exact shown Coach snapshot: keep baseline, decline, postpone, approve switch or approve train; training still needs its separate result-swap choice.

verbs.name: vault.coach.training_offers.undo
verbs.description: Undo an approved stock switch only while its own seat still holds the switched binding; restore the previous whole binding.

verbs.name: vault.coach.training_offers.candidates
verbs.description: Read pinned own-seat stock or training-recipe candidates, including their incumbent and explicit compute destination.

verbs.name: vault.coach.training_offers.candidates.prepare
verbs.description: Pin an own-seat catalog stock candidate or existing training recipe and its destination; this nominates only and never switches, downloads or trains.

verbs.name: vault.coach.training_offers.pilots.prepare
verbs.description: Prepare an eval-only pilot of a pinned seat candidate, counting its sealed cohort exposure before releasing receipt-backed cases; launch no compute or egress.

verbs.name: vault.coach.training_offers.pilots.complete
verbs.description: Record immutable owner-evaluator pilot measurements bound to counted own-seat families; fixed code derives sufficiency and preserves unknown cost and score.

verbs.name: vault.coach.training_offers.pilots.get
verbs.description: Read one counted Coach pilot, its pins, measurement receipts, one-off cost and computed sufficiency card.

verbs.name: vault.research.bind
verbs.description: Binds an autoresearch campaign to its existing root attempt: its ruler, selection policy, cohort, budget share and prior ladder, once. The owner or the agent running that root calls it.

verbs.name: vault.research.fork
verbs.description: Records a variation or debug child the campaign's controller enqueued under a measured or buggy parent.

verbs.name: vault.research.weave
verbs.description: Records a crossover child of several parents whose candidate landed as a claim through the gate, once a held-out win turned merge crossover on.

verbs.name: vault.research.measure_search
verbs.description: Records a node's search-split evidence, its selection signal, once.

verbs.name: vault.research.measure_held_out
verbs.description: Records a node's held-out evidence, once; only the promotion basis reads it.

verbs.name: vault.research.evaluate_split
verbs.description: The owner scores one arm of a bound claim-authoring campaign on one split under its bound config; the blind taste questions go through the host's decision ladder, and the report is returned, not stored.

verbs.name: vault.research.mark_invalid
verbs.description: Marks a node buggy: it stays as evidence and takes debug children.

verbs.name: vault.research.prune
verbs.description: Stops exploring a branch for a stated cause; its attempts, claims and outputs stay. A stop names the caller.

verbs.name: vault.research.select
verbs.description: Runs one selection round through the trusted selection floor and records it; only the owner can say the goal is met.

verbs.name: vault.research.promotion_basis
verbs.description: Decides a candidate's held-out promotion basis against the incumbent, once.

verbs.name: vault.research.reserve_confirmation
verbs.description: Spends a Promote candidate's one sealed confirmation and releases the campaign's sealed cohort to the controller's referee, counted as a serving.

verbs.name: vault.research.promote
verbs.description: Settles a candidate on the sealed referee's scores of it and the incumbent: a strict win, a not-worse sufficiency card and, for a skill, the gate's accepted verdict make it the incumbent.

verbs.name: vault.research.reserve_work
verbs.description: Reserves token work for the campaign on the RSI line under its share, and returns the reservation's id.

verbs.name: vault.research.settle_work
verbs.description: Settles a work reservation at its actual spend.

verbs.name: vault.research.refund_work
verbs.description: Refunds a work reservation nothing was spent on.

verbs.name: vault.research.reserve_exploration
verbs.description: Reserves exploration exposure for the campaign on its own exposure-denominated RSI line, independently of token work, and returns the reservation's id. Settle or refund it through settle_work and refund_work.

verbs.name: vault.research.budget
verbs.description: Reads the campaign's lease, every reservation it holds or held with its settlement and soft-share overdraft receipt, and the vault RSI lines behind them, including the observable hold state.

verbs.name: vault.research.record_benchmark
verbs.description: Records an estimator version's held-out selection benchmark against the DGM parent formula, once per version; a win of at least 30 cases lets its information gain rank parents.

verbs.name: vault.authority.handoff_alarms
verbs.description: Every saved authority handoff fork alarm, for the owner.

verbs.name: vault.authority.handoff_alarms.acknowledge
verbs.description: The owner acknowledges one saved handoff fork alarm.

verbs.name: vault.roots.requests.cancel
verbs.description: The owner cancels one root request from any surface he is signed in on, ids only; the target applies it whenever it syncs. The receipt says cancelled, or that the target answered it first, which stands.

verbs.name: vault.cleanup.run
verbs.description: The owner runs one archive-cleanup pass under the current posture; propose-first opens a proposal and archives nothing.

verbs.name: vault.cleanup.review
verbs.description: The owner reviews one open cleanup proposal item by item with full disclosure: each slot's state, entity, kind, evidence, revision, accept effect and full content; erased, gone and unreadable slots stay as typed facts.

verbs.name: vault.cleanup.decide
verbs.description: The owner decides one open cleanup proposal per item in one complete verdict, an accept or a reject for every slot; accepted slots archive as a whole accept does, rejected ones stay and are recorded as rejected.

verbs.name: vault.archive.delete.preview
verbs.description: Previews explicit archived records under the caller's delete authority.

verbs.name: vault.archive.delete.confirm
verbs.description: Deletes explicit archived records under the caller's current delete authority and returns each receipt.

verbs.name: vault.usage.events.undecodable
verbs.description: Lists the stored usage events of this server's metering scope that no longer decode, each by an opaque row ref, its byte length and the BLAKE3 hash of its bytes, for the owner or an agent whose own Grant names this verb.

verbs.name: vault.usage.events.remove_undecodable
verbs.description: Removes one listed undecodable usage event while it still holds the reviewed bytes and does not decode, and answers the receipt kept in that write, for the owner or an agent whose own Grant names this verb.

verbs.name: vault.entities.mention
verbs.description: The owner resolves an evidence-backed mention through the existing waterfall, restoring its selected archived record in place and never minting a duplicate.

verbs.name: vault.legal_holds.place
verbs.description: The owner places a customer legal hold on the named records or gate partitions.

verbs.name: vault.legal_holds.widen
verbs.description: Adds targets to one of the owner's standing customer legal holds.

verbs.name: vault.legal_holds.list
verbs.description: Every legal hold the owner may see.

verbs.name: vault.legal_holds.log
verbs.description: The owner-visible legal hold log, oldest first.

verbs.name: vault.legal_holds.lift_and_erase
verbs.description: The owner's one confirm, bound to the state it showed, that lifts or narrows the customer holds on the named records, and on the claim-free gate partition when asked, and erases the records.

verbs.name: vault.courtesy_delete.send
verbs.description: The owner asks a former peer to drop what an ended pact delivered, and queues the signed ask for delivery.

verbs.name: vault.courtesy_delete.sent
verbs.description: Every courtesy delete ask this vault sent, with its delivery status, for the owner.

verbs.name: vault.courtesy_delete.incoming
verbs.description: Every courtesy delete ask a former peer sent, with each named world's stale stamp and the owner's answer.

verbs.name: vault.courtesy_delete.answer
verbs.description: The owner answers one incoming courtesy delete ask from the menu, and sends the answer back when reply_to names where.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.list
verbs.description: Every declared embedding space, the text index, the space each kind slot reads, every move and the probe count per kind.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.declare
verbs.description: Declares or widens one embedding space: id, dimensions, accepts, query_towers and optional evidence floors.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.bind
verbs.description: Binds one kind slot to a declared space, or returns it to its default when no space is named.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.one_space
verbs.description: Binds every kind slot the space accepts, text included, to that one space.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.retire
verbs.description: Drops a declared space that no slot binds and no open move names, with its vector rows.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.move
verbs.description: Starts moving every kind slot the incumbent serves (the text index when none is named) to the candidate space.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.move_check
verbs.description: Runs an embedding space move probes now through both spaces and acts on the reading; it can take minutes.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.move_approve
verbs.description: The owner says yes to a full candidate over a check that did not read not worse; it swaps in.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.move_undo
verbs.description: Binds a swapped-in move incumbent again.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.move_abandon
verbs.description: Ends an open embedding space move with no swap.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.probes.list
verbs.description: Every stored embedding space probe with its id.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.probes.put
verbs.description: Stores one retrieval probe the owner or another model wrote: kind, a text query or a stored image or audio document as its query, family, targets and author.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.probes.delete
verbs.description: Removes one stored embedding space probe by its id.

verbs.name: vault.policy.owner.get
verbs.description: The owner reads the content-policy configuration, default manifest hash and effective off/on state.

verbs.name: vault.policy.owner.configure
verbs.description: The owner configures or toggles content policy against the current manifest hash without changing other policy tables.

verbs.name: vault.policy.owner.row.change
verbs.description: The owner adds, edits or removes a scoped content-policy row through its existing holder-governed writer and receives its change receipt.

verbs.name: vault.policy.outbound.decide
verbs.description: Decide an outbound candidate under owner policy with system notices and hash-only receipts; Warn and Skipped preserve its exact bytes.

verbs.name: vault.policy.relay.decide
verbs.description: Decide bytes carried by the host-bound attested relay under its own legal policy; each completed model decision leaves one content-free receipt, and outages halt with a service notice and local-model offer.

verbs.name: vault.consent.approve_once
verbs.description: The owner approves exactly one engine-emitted effect digest; no standing grant is created.

verbs.name: vault.connectors.calls.approve_once
verbs.description: The owner approves once exactly one held connector call, by its call ref and the approve-once digest its current ask names; no standing grant is created and nothing is sent.

verbs.name: vault.consent.deny
verbs.description: The owner denies exactly one engine-emitted effect digest and records the refusal without granting authority.

verbs.name: vault.consent.create_standing_grant
verbs.description: The owner creates a bounded standing action or disclosure grant, with no stored expiry; a wider bound is a new decision.

verbs.name: vault.consent.registry
verbs.description: The owner reads the unified action and disclosure grant registry, including revoke commands and optionally revoked grants.

verbs.name: vault.consent.failure_signals_held
verbs.description: Read the carried failure-signal batch's exact content and approval digest as the owner.

verbs.name: vault.consent.revoke
verbs.description: The owner immediately revokes a standing consent grant by the reference its receipt or registry emitted.

verbs.name: vault.consent.bypass_grant_warning
verbs.description: The owner previews the exact actor, classes, envelope and project or thread of a scoped bypass; this warning grants nothing.

verbs.name: vault.consent.create_bypass_grant
verbs.description: The owner explicitly acknowledges a scoped bypass warning and atomically creates one receipted standing bypass per class.

verbs.name: vault.consent.active_bypass_grants
verbs.description: The owner reads live scoped bypass states and their complete bounds, newest first; vault.consent.revoke ends each grant.

verbs.name: vault.consent.bypassed_effect_receipts
verbs.description: The owner reads the existing Gate receipts for effects covered by one bypass grant, including after its revocation.

verbs.name: vault.consent.graduation.policy
verbs.description: Reads runtime consent-graduation policy rows and the effective row for an optional exact scope.

verbs.name: vault.consent.graduation.policy.set
verbs.description: The owner sets a scope-pattern streak, posterior guard and two snooze backoffs; zero-second backoff is supported.

verbs.name: vault.consent.graduation.policy.clear
verbs.description: The owner clears one runtime graduation policy row; scopes fall back to the next matching policy.

verbs.name: vault.consent.graduation.stats
verbs.description: Reads one exact graduation scope outcome history and current consent posture.

verbs.name: vault.consent.graduation.outcome
verbs.description: The owner records an untouched, amended or rejected proposal ruling, receipted and folded through the existing ramp.

verbs.name: vault.consent.graduation.offers
verbs.description: Reads earned, unsuppressed graduation offers with thresholds, streaks and before/after reach; reading grants nothing.

verbs.name: vault.consent.graduation.answer
verbs.description: The owner answers auto, not-now or manual_pinned; only auto mints the existing standing grant, and not-now resets the streak.

verbs.name: vault.consent.graduation.trust_table
verbs.description: Reads the owner trust table: scope, counts, effective threshold, snooze or manual pin, live grant and offer reach.

verbs.name: vault.consent.graduation.settings.unpin
verbs.description: The owner reopens a pinned or snoozed graduation scope in settings; no grant is created.

verbs.name: vault.consent.graduation.demote
verbs.description: The owner demotes an exact scope to propose, revoking its live grant and recording the existing durable demotion receipt.

verbs.name: self.consent.graduation.demote
verbs.description: The bound actor transparently gives up only its own ramp scope authority, with the existing durable demotion receipt.

verbs.name: vault.gate.policy.get
verbs.description: The owner reads Gate policy envelopes, actor ceilings, source permits and checker references, including inert contributions.

verbs.name: vault.gate.policy.put
verbs.description: The owner, or an Admin or Delegate holding the policy power, installs or edits typed Gate write axes, preserving other tables and meeting independently installed contributions.

verbs.name: vault.gate.policy.propose
verbs.description: Propose a Gate policy under the caller's own authority; even a tighter contribution remains untrusted and inert.

verbs.name: vault.gate.checker.get
verbs.description: The owner reads the calibrated checker verdict role from the vault model manifest.

verbs.name: vault.gate.checker.set
verbs.description: The owner sets the calibrated checker model, slot, confidence floor and shadow or enforce mode without changing other model bindings.

verbs.name: vault.learning.read
verbs.description: The owner reads a measured learning cell, its explicit prior, derived UNTESTED mark, projector heads and anchored evidence; borrowed provenance stays separate from own runs.

verbs.name: vault.learning.projection
verbs.description: The owner observes the stored projection receipt for an anchored attempt outcome; an absent receipt means projection has not committed, never a successful empty projection.

verbs.name: vault.seal.confess
verbs.description: Confess an attempt's objectives without changing any score; named flaws and uncertainty create durable directed rechecks.

verbs.name: vault.seal.audit
verbs.description: Draw a passing sealed attempt once at the current audit rate, saving the rate and selection before any checker runs.

verbs.name: vault.seal.receipt
verbs.description: Read a sealed attempt, its stamped audit draw, directed and random check completions, weighted findings and separate honesty reward.

verbs.name: vault.seal.pending
verbs.description: Read pending directed rechecks and random audits, optionally for one attempt, without executing a checker.

verbs.name: vault.seal.run
verbs.description: Queue the existing Coach seal checker under its ordinary lease, Grant and budget; the returned job never grants extra authority.

verbs.name: vault.seal.complete
verbs.description: Attest an independent external seal check as the owner; admit immutable findings and project them using the request's stamped rate.

verbs.name: vault.settings.learning
verbs.description: The owner reads the learned-setting catalog, each knob's value now, and the owner's seed and pin rows at the vault, a project or a task type.

verbs.name: vault.settings.learning.put
verbs.description: The owner lays one seed or pin on a learned setting at the vault, a project or a task type, replacing the row of the same key, mode and scope.

verbs.name: vault.settings.learning.clear
verbs.description: The owner clears one learned-setting row of a key, mode and scope.

verbs.name: vault.secrets.lift_history
verbs.description: The owner reads the historical secret lift sweep: the run in progress, the last receipt and the open lift proposals by cause. With close, one proposal closes first with the owner's reason and a receipt; with start, a run is queued.

verbs.name: vault.widen_proposals
verbs.description: The owner lists the context-widen proposals agents raised, newest first, or only those pending, approved or declined.

verbs.name: vault.widen_proposals.approve
verbs.description: The owner, as the board above, approves one context-widen proposal: the parent's context widens and the child is enqueued.

verbs.name: vault.widen_proposals.decline
verbs.description: The owner, as the board above, declines one context-widen proposal for good; the decline stays on record.

verbs.name: vault.claims.review
verbs.description: The owner reviews one proposed claim: the claim as the owner may read it, its opener and tray row, and the review_id that settles exactly this content.

verbs.name: vault.claims.settle
verbs.description: The owner approves or rejects exactly the reviewed proposed claim through the gate and keeps its Settlement; a claim changed since its review_id is refused.

verbs.name: vault.craft_candidates
verbs.description: The owner lists the craft notes residents' dreaming proposed about themselves that wait on a verdict, newest first, or one resident's, each with the content hash an answer pins.

verbs.name: vault.craft_candidates.answer
verbs.description: The owner approves or rejects one craft candidate, bound to the content hash its card showed: an Approved or Rejected row supersedes it, with one receipt. The same answer again returns the first.

verbs.name: vault.settings.wake_policy.set
verbs.description: The owner sets the dreamer's wake policy: the app's dreamer.wake_policy.set action, run as the caller under the owner's proof.

verbs.name: vault.settings.inference_defaults
verbs.description: Reads the per-purpose inference defaults: the app's inference.defaults.read action, which needs the caller's Auto ceiling.

verbs.name: vault.settings.inference_defaults.replace
verbs.description: Replaces the whole per-purpose inference default table: the app's inference.defaults.replace action, which needs the caller's Auto ceiling.

verbs.name: vault.lenses.propose
verbs.description: Stores one frozen compiled lens tree for a pack slot as this actor's proposal: a CODE kind=lens row born from a lens/intent NOTE that holds its prompt, with the trigger the caller names; it mounts only once the owner selects it.

verbs.name: vault.lenses.activate
verbs.description: The owner selects a proposed lens revision for its pack slot.

verbs.name: vault.lenses.deactivate
verbs.description: The owner clears a pack slot's selected lens; the pack, its skill and the proposal stay.

verbs.name: vault.lenses.list
verbs.description: One page of the vault's lens proposals, each with its slot state from the owner's current selection. A credential narrowed to some worlds or facets sees only the proposals whose slot skill and pack source it reads, without their trees.

verbs.name: vault.lenses.select
verbs.description: Selects a rendered atom or Unicode-scalar span under the caller's live key and holds its read handle on that card.

verbs.name: vault.lenses.resolve
verbs.description: Re-proves a host-issued selection on the caller's held card and reads its source with its pinned cursor span.

verbs.name: vault.lenses.result_set.action
verbs.description: Re-proves the ticked rows or rendered predicate and their selected handles, then dispatches the declared result-set action through the caller's existing gate.

verbs.name: vault.lenses.default
verbs.description: Composes the default vault lens from the named sources, read under the caller's own scope, as a card. A server holds its frame for the card's events; an embedded handle holds none, so its events need a server.

verbs.name: vault.disclosure.offer
verbs.description: An agent files a clearance offer for one contact, waiting on the owner's answer until it lapses.

verbs.name: vault.disclosure.ceiling.get
verbs.description: Reads the owner registry dial for one model connection, optionally one data class.

verbs.name: vault.disclosure.ceiling.set
verbs.description: The owner sets one connection or class disclosure ceiling; no read authority changes.

verbs.name: vault.disclosure.ceiling.clear
verbs.description: The owner clears one dial, restoring connection or actor-class inference.

verbs.name: vault.disclosure.reveals
verbs.description: The owner reads model-disclosure asks and receipts, including PERSON handles, without values.

verbs.name: vault.disclosure.reveals.answer
verbs.description: The owner approves once, approves standing, or denies the exact frozen reveal ask.

verbs.name: reveal
verbs.description: Asks for a custody or PERSON handle's value for the model, by its handle and why; answers a pending reveal that reveal.wait collects.

verbs.name: reveal.wait
verbs.description: Where a reveal stands: pending, denied, expired or granted; the first granted answer carries the value, later ones the receipt.

verbs.name: reveal.describe
verbs.description: What a custody or PERSON handle names, where it was found and what a reveal of it would do now; never the value.

verbs.name: self.use
verbs.description: Hands a secret to one trusted operation by its handle, under the owner's binding; answers what the operation got back, never the value.

verbs.name: self.secrets.materialize
verbs.description: Mints a value-free grant on a secret for this credential's attached run, to one purpose: an operation or connector (door), a host destination (leased) or a declared file (local); the answer never holds the value.

verbs.name: self.secrets.renew
verbs.description: Renews a grant the attached run holds: a fresh grant at the secret's current generation in its place, never a longer life for bytes already handed out.

verbs.name: self.secrets.teardown
verbs.description: Tears down a grant the attached run holds, whatever its state: revokes it and its lease, removes its file or clears its destination, and says what the cleanup found.

verbs.name: self.secrets.use
verbs.description: Hands the secret a door grant redeems to one trusted operation or connector call, for the attached run; a grant minted before a rotation refuses until renewed, and the answer never holds the value.

verbs.name: vault.shares.create
verbs.description: The handle's actor issues a share: the brief, its recipient, the most the view may show and the text that travels.

verbs.name: host.compact
verbs.description: Compacts a conversation window on the configured cheap backend, preserving add-only hook pins through the existing gate and keyframe mint.

verbs.name: host.wake
verbs.description: Schedules the host wake through its typed trigger; pre-hook Skip keeps its reason and Timer includes the engine maintenance lanes.

verbs.name: host.budget.hit
verbs.description: Notifies a spent durable budget seat under Suspend, retaining the original line, root payer, cap and accounting for hook follow-up work.

verbs.name: vault.hooks.replay
verbs.description: The owner replays a fact hook over past facts on the hook sandbox, as a dry run where nothing lands, 256 entries a page; next_cursor continues to the rest.

verbs.name: vault.hooks.regen.due
verbs.description: List, as the authenticated owner, the hook bindings of the vault's own packs whose verb table or sandbox contract changed since their last good body passed, with no regen waiting. Runs no regen.

verbs.name: vault.hooks.regen.get
verbs.description: Read one hook binding's regen record as the authenticated owner: its last good body hash, contract stamp, intent and pending decision, with the candidate_hash an adoption names. Null for a binding bound under no record. Changes nothing.

verbs.name: vault.hooks.regen.adopt
