verbs.description: Adopt, as the authenticated owner and as their stamp, the regen candidate pending on one hook binding, named by the candidate_hash vault.hooks.regen.get shows. Answers the pack put receipt; only an installed put advances the record.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.publish_approval
verbs.description: Computes the exact publication approval digest for the existing owner approve-once door; it grants nothing.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.publish
verbs.description: Publishes one immutable code fork or numbered blob export with an explicit audience through the existing Gate, returning its pointer and durable receipt ref.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.repoint
verbs.description: Repoints one artifact channel to an exact immutable export through the publication Gate; use a new publish id, and earlier receipts survive.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.pointer
verbs.description: Reads the current artifact channel pin and audience under the owner credential; null when absent or withheld.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.unpublish
verbs.description: Removes one artifact channel pointer without deleting its immutable export or earlier publication receipts.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.link_token
verbs.description: Mints a serving-only link token and its digest tier; publication still requires a separate exact Gate authorization.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.live_preview.register
verbs.description: Opens a draft-labelled, owner-private live preview only for the exact process, port and lease already declared by the trusted session runtime.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.live_preview.read
verbs.description: Reads a live draft endpoint and a caller-specific preview URL as the owner or a named invitee; uninvited callers are refused.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.live_preview.close
verbs.description: Closes one owner-private preview lease, invalidating its old URLs, streams and upgrades without changing any published artifact pin.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.live_preview.invite
verbs.description: Invites one named principal to a private live preview under the lease owner proof; no public audience is created.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.live_preview.revoke_invite
verbs.description: Revokes one private preview invitation and its personal credentials, including active streams.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.live_preview.share
verbs.description: Mints a revocable sharing URL for one private live preview, replacing any earlier sharing URL; no artifact is published.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.live_preview.revoke_share
verbs.description: Revokes the private preview sharing URL and streams that used it while preserving separate owner and invitee credentials.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.view
verbs.description: One artifact: its kind, name, type, head and every version with its made_by and born-from.

docs.remote: /// One artifact's kind, head and versions, each with its made_by and born-from.
docs.ts: /** One artifact's kind, head and versions, each with its made_by and born-from. */
docs.py: One artifact's kind, head and versions, each with its made_by and born-from.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.units
verbs.description: Inspects real DOCX blocks, XLSX cells and PPTX shapes in one version; other kinds explicitly report no annotation unit adapter.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.anchors.pin
verbs.description: Pins an exact readable locator and quote in an artifact version; opening a thread makes the pin durable.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.threads.open
verbs.description: Opens an anchored thread with its first comment as the caller, retaining its exact version, locator and quote.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.threads.comment
verbs.description: Appends a comment as the caller; returns its first stored part, with every part available through threads.read.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.threads.read
verbs.description: Reads a thread, its opening quote, current anchor, explicit pinned, mapped or drifted disposition, comments and assignment.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.threads.list
verbs.description: Lists an artifact's readable threads with their opening pins, current anchors, drift, comments and assignments.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.threads.assign
verbs.description: Assigns an anchored thread into a durable task brief with its anchor and transcript; an agent-definition assignee dispatches through the engine.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.threads.state
verbs.description: Opens or resolves a thread through its existing claim gate, preserving its anchor, comments and drift.

verbs.name: mount
verbs.description: Open the caller-scoped live graph or a retained repository snapshot, resolving a snapshot id to its exact fork hash.

verbs.name: graph_fs.readdir
verbs.description: List one directory at the mounted reference under the caller read gate, with a sealed continuation.

verbs.name: graph_fs.read_file
verbs.description: Read a bounded page of file bytes at the mounted reference, with its encoding and sealed continuation.

verbs.name: graph_fs.read_link
verbs.description: Resolve a visible graph link at the mounted reference without following a host filesystem link.

verbs.name: graph_fs.ls
verbs.description: List names at the mounted reference, using the live temporal index when requested.

verbs.name: graph_fs.find
verbs.description: Walk visible paths at the mounted reference, or push a live newer-than query into the temporal index.

verbs.name: graph_fs.grep
verbs.description: Search visible mounted file bytes, using the live claim text index for supported recursive patterns.

verbs.name: graph_fs.cat
verbs.description: Read a bounded page of mounted file bytes as UTF-8 or base64 without changing its reference.

verbs.name: graph_fs.head
verbs.description: Read the first requested lines at the mounted reference with bounded output and a sealed continuation.

verbs.name: graph_fs.wc
verbs.description: Count lines, words and bytes of a visible file at the mounted reference.

verbs.name: vault.code.diff
verbs.description: The semantic changes between two tested states of one code file, each unit with the operations that made it: actor, session, turn, activity, intent, model and effort.

docs.remote: /// The semantic changes between two tested states of one code file, each with the operations that made it.

docs.py: The semantic changes between two tested states of one code file, each with the operations that made it.

verbs.name: vault.code.blame
verbs.description: Every unit of one tested state of a code file, with the runs of text each operation wrote, and who made each operation and why.

docs.remote: /// Every unit of one tested code file state, blamed by the operations that wrote it.
docs.ts: /** Every unit of one tested code file state, blamed by the operations that wrote it. */

verbs.name: vault.code.proposal_view
verbs.description: One repo proposal as a reviewer reads it: its candidate against the file at its base, unit by unit, under the provenance it was proposed with, and the operation it landed as once applied.

docs.remote: /// One repo proposal's semantic change from its base, under the provenance it was proposed with.
docs.ts: /** One repo proposal's semantic change from its base, under the provenance it was proposed with. */

verbs.name: vault.code.symbols.declare
verbs.description: Declare the current repository symbols a task will touch, held by the caller until host time plus ttl_seconds. Owner only. An overlap waits behind the tasks it names, never refused; it grants no write, approval or landing.

verbs.name: vault.code.symbols.renew
verbs.description: Renew the live symbol declaration the caller holds for one task by its declared lifetime. Owner only.

verbs.name: vault.code.symbols.release
verbs.description: Release the symbol declaration the caller holds for one task. Owner only. Keyed by task and holder with no epoch fence; it applies, approves and schedules nothing.

verbs.name: vault.code.proposal_submit
verbs.description: Stage one file change of a repository as a Proposed proposal with its retained base, under the owner's lens catalog or, with none, the vault's review policy. Owner only. Nothing is approved, queued or landed.

verbs.name: vault.code.conflict_record
verbs.description: Record a real Git overlap between two stored one-file proposals at the same retained base, with both trees, paths and a linked reconciliation task. Owner only; neither branch moves.

verbs.name: vault.code.conflict_view
verbs.description: Read open repository conflicts and their durable resolution claims, including each reconciliation task. Owner only.

verbs.name: vault.code.proposal_resolve
verbs.description: Stage a one-file resolution of an active repository conflict as another Proposed proposal, preserving its original proposals and reconciliation task. Owner only; nothing lands.

verbs.name: vault.code.proposal_review
verbs.description: Record the authenticated owner's immutable critic opinion on one proposal lens. Independent reviewers only; this is no contract-check execution receipt.

verbs.name: vault.code.proposal_settle
verbs.description: Approve or reject one code proposal as an independent owner, keeping a receipt. Its own catalog still needs unanimous critics; Approve satisfies the vault's review policy. Only the tested merge queue lands it.

verbs.name: vault.code.proposal_settlement
verbs.description: Read a code proposal's review decision receipt and execution lineage, including its conflict, original proposals, reconciliation task and resolution claim. Owner only.

verbs.name: vault.code.oplog
